data.name: Ozen
data.description: OZEN Sp. z o.o. (OZEN Plus) is a Polish charcoal manufacturer in Wałcz operating since 2011, producing about 20,000 tonnes/year of charcoal and charcoal briquettes plus about 52,000 MWh of electricity from pyrolysis heat. The company's core business is grill/BBQ charcoal sold primarily to the German market; biochar/C-Sink certification is an adjacent activity on part of its output.
